changelog: A film in a film-night block no longer also plays in the channel's regular rotation - true of every channel, not only suggestions. The Look page now shows the actual picture for a channel look borrowed from a title, directly in the three picture slots instead of only naming it underneath; the poster card is also no wider than the picture itself. Adding a film now offers its other parts too: channel suggestions complete them automatically, and adding by hand - to a channel's content, a block, or the "from titles I like" start - shows them as one-click chips.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
